title: Augmenting hemopexin-mediated heme scavenging mitigates sepsis-induced acute kidney injury in humanized sickle cell mice.
snippet: Sickle cell disease (SCD) is characterized by chronic intravascular hemolysis and depletion of the heme scavenger hemopexin (HPX), generating a high-heme milieu that may increase susceptibility to inflammatory organ injury. title: TLS as Predictors and Targets in Neoadjuvant Chemoimmunotherapy for NSCLC.
snippet: Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) have emerged as critical modulators of antitumor immunity in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with growing evidence supporting their role as both prognostic biomarkers and functional targets in neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy.
